description.p: Snipunix captures the screen through the desktop Screenshot portal, lets you choose a region from a frozen image, and copies it to the clipboard. You can copy, save as PNG, or reopen the frozen overlay to adjust the region. A delay of up to ten seconds is available before the capture.

The annotation editor adds pen, highlighter, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, text, eraser, crop, and opaque redaction tools with undo and redo, plus selection, move, and resize. Copy the annotated result to the clipboard or export it as PNG, JPEG, or WebP from a native save dialog.

Text recognition runs entirely on this device with a bundled local model. Extracted text can be copied or have its line breaks removed, and detected email addresses and phone numbers can be covered with undoable redaction blocks. The models are installed with the application; downloading is an explicit opt-in for host builds.

Settings and onboarding cover capture defaults, rebindable global shortcuts, save folders and formats, local OCR options, and overlay appearance. A best-effort tray exposes capture, settings, and quit when the desktop provides a StatusNotifierItem host.
Images stay in memory until you save them. Snipunix works locally, does not upload anything, and contains no telemetry.

M3: local English OCR with selectable text and line-break control, detected email and phone redaction, persisted settings and first-run onboarding, rebindable global shortcuts with a fallback guide, a best-effort StatusNotifierItem tray, and Flatpak/deb packages that bundle the OCR models.

M2: non-destructive annotation editor with pen, highlighter, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, UTF-8 text, eraser, crop, selection move and resize, undo and redo, shared screen/export rendering, Copy Annotated, and PNG/JPEG/WebP export.
M1: move and resize handles, magnifier, delay countdown, clipboard copy, Save As, Adjust Region, keyboard nudging, and clipboard ownership while the app stays resident.
Initial M0 capture and region-selection prototype.
